mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing the cost of capital and boosting equity valuations, which produces positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.5% signals economic distress, reducing corporate earnings expectations and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1500 and consumer spending (RSAFS) exceeds 500000, robust demand conditions support corporate growth, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST > 1500 and RSAFS > 500000, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During industrial production growth phases (INDPRO > 105), sustained manufacturing output supports economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when INDPRO > 105, SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Low consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) indicates stable price environment, reducing uncertainty and supporting equity valuations, which yields positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL < 250.

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market (PAYEMS > 140000) reflects robust economic activity, increasing corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 140000.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) exceeds 105 and employment (PAYEMS) exceeds 140000, the combined supply and labor market strength signals economic expansion, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO > 105 and PAYEMS > 140000, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 260) triggers expectations of monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, which causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when CPIAUCSL > 260, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances.
